newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ visitor numbers up five pct in Mar qtr, yr/yr.
newsitem.headline: NZ visitor numbers up five pct in Mar qtr, yr/yr.

text.p: Overseas visitor arrivals to New Zealand totalled 470,600 in the March quarter, up five percent on the March 1996 quarter, Statistics New Zealand said on Friday.

The largest source region for overseas visitors was Asia, accounting for just under one third of all visitors in the March quarter. This represented an increase of three percent over the March 1996 quarter.
New Zealand residents leaving for short overseas trips totalled 205,900, up seven percent over the March 1996 quarter.
